feeds.title: Just Airsoft Guns Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Just airsoft guns blog page. Here you can find all the information about airsoft guns, gear, how to maintain them, etc. Our many years of industry experience means that we always strive to offer our customers discounted prices on Airsoft Rifles and Airsoft Pistols so that whether you are looking for a gun for skirmishing or for target practice, we have an option suitable for you at an affordable price.

feeds.title: Airsoft Action Magazine
feeds.description: Airsoft Action Magazine is a free-to-read magazine that covers weaponry, wear and gear, armory, and more.

feeds.title: Airsoft & Milsim News
feeds.description: Airsoft & MilSim News Blog is an award-winning news site specializing in premium quality reviews and presentations for the airsoft, milsim, and tactical industry.

feeds.title: Popular Airsoft
feeds.description: Popular Airsoft is a website dedicated to promoting Airsoft. We aim to scrounge the earth and the internet to find information about everything airsoft. Yes, that's right, from airsoft weapons, and airsoft gear, to airsoft sites, to types of airsoft game plays, to airsoft websites, and airsoft teams. We aim to search each nook and cranny to find information and bring it to the Popular Airsoft website.

feeds.title: Airsoftology
feeds.description: Started as a humble podcast in 2008, Airsoftology has since grown into a multi-program franchise with an internationally followed internet radio show, professionally produced product and gear reviews, airsoft how-tos, and more! The recipe for Airsoftology's growth has been simple: Create a high-quality program that airsoft players want to see, host all of the programs with avid airsofters (not hired actors), and produce each segment to professional standards.

feeds.title: Airsoft International Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Ai-Mag - Airsoft International HQ. Ai, as we are known amongst friends, has been established for well over 17 years and is currently the most popular airsoft magazine in existence but we are so much more than just a printed product! The Ai brand has become a family, maybe even a cult over the years with numerous achievements and accomplishments under our belts.

feeds.title: Femme Fatale Airsoft Blog
feeds.description: Femme Fatale Airsoft is where airsofters, and outdoor and firearms enthusiasts can find reviews on everything from airsoft guns and accessories to tactical kits! Alongside the airsoft site and event reviews, loadouts/setups, how-to articles, and loads more! I test everything - the good, the bad, cheap and expensive so you don't have to.

feeds.title: Novritsch Blog
feeds.description: Novritsch Blog is a blog focused on airsoft, it compares guns, shares how-tos, and airsoft guides, and also has a store to shop from.

feeds.title: Jungle's Airsoft Blog
feeds.description: Life is a game, Airsoft is serious! My name is Jim, people started to call me 'Jungle Jim' when I got into airsoft in 2006 and began the slide into spending way too much time and money on the sport! I hope you will find my posts interesting and useful as I plan to put up some of my technical trickery and maintenance tips alongside reviews and custom builds.

feeds.title: Recon Brothers Blog
feeds.description: Learn everything about tactical equipment, training & maintenance! On this blog page, you can find all the correct information regarding (airsoft) guns, tactical equipment, how to maintain them, product reviews, etc. These blogs are always based on the information we get from the experts themselves and we add our own personal experiences to them as well.
